prior_policy.qso: Preserve every numerical QSO abundance-prior value, grid and completeness constant from the active bundle. Increased spectroscopic training counts are not an abundance calibration.
prior_policy.stellar: Use all fit+select stellar counts. Legacy optical uses measured per-band masked area. Other bands retain the historical convention: base Legacy usable area of cones with any usable measurement in the survey; flag these areas as approximate, not measured external-survey footprints.
prior_policy.magnitude_edges: Inherit reference-prior edges; merge adjacent stellar bins only if pooled counts are zero. Record counts outside the retained range.

policy: Freeze the existing density and spatial model. Complete priors and catch-all, then diagnose bright stellar optical evidence. Never refit shapes, acquire data, or change the active pointer. Subsequent complete-score release checks remain separate.
